The '''Terror Walker''' was a massive [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attack [[Walker/Legends|walker]] developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was designed to plow through large obstructions and annihilate anything in its path.

==History==
Prior to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Assault on Kamino|assault]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was tasked with [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|infiltrating]] the Rebel [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. Acting under orders from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was accompanied by a complement of specialized units, including [[Terror Trooper|terror troopers]], [[Terror Droid|specialized droids]] and the Terror Walker.

The Terror Walker was released onto the [[Salvation (flagship)|Salvation]], and immediately began rampaging through the vessel, leveling all in its path. Its actions allowed companies of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to access various areas of the ship and assist Boba Fett in his objective&mdash;capturing [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

Fett was ultimately successful; however, the arrival of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and [[Subject 1138|the clone of]] [[Galen Marek]] coincided with his mission, and the Terror Walker engaged Marek's clone in single combat in the ship's core.

==Destruction==
[[File:Titan_Droid_TFU2_E3.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] attacks the Terror Walker.]]

The Terror Walker fought against Marek's [[Subject 1138|clone]] in the ''Salvation''{{'s}} [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], a battlefield that would bring about its end. Using the reactor itself to deactivate the Walker's shield, Marek was able to damage the Terror Walker and commandeer it.

The Terror Walker was rammed into the core, and proceeded to self-destruct. Its devastated body was later utilized by the clone to escape the volatile area. Whatever remained of the droid was obliterated when the ''Salvation'' impacted into [[Timira City]], destroying it. 

==Capabilities==
{{Quote|I actually feel sorry for the poor rebel fools that this thing is unleashed upon.|Anonymous Imperial Medical Officer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />}}
This large droid was capable of exterminating almost anything in its way, thanks to its sharp claws. It was also armed with missiles and lasers to further increase its destructive capabilities. In this droid also comes the [[Terror Droid]]s, smaller arachnid-type robots that attached themselves to unwilling victims.

==Behind the scenes==
The Terror Walker was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', and makes its first appearance in the final stages of the level "Aboard the Salvation"; the fight against the Terror Walker marks the end of the said chapter. An entry on the Terror Walker's creation is also included in the game's databank.

In the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novel]], the Terror Walker was destroyed when the clone hurled it into space while the ''Salvation'' was traveling through hyperspace. In the Wii version, the Terror Walker struggled to move, only to be sucked into the generating hyperdrive waves.

It's also believed that the Terror Walker was likely created from the apex predator [[Acklay]]. This is due to its scream being the exact same as the [[Acklay]] shown in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones]].
